tagline: Enclosed 20W diode — safer home engraving with moderate cutting

faq.question: Is the xTool S1 safer than an open-frame laser?
faq.answer: Yes. The enclosure blocks direct beam exposure and contains smoke. You still follow safety rules, but accidental exposure risk is much lower than open-frame diodes.

faq.question: Can the S1 replace a CO₂ laser?
faq.answer: No. It is still a diode laser with the same acrylic and cutting limits. Buy CO₂ (like xTool P2) if clear acrylic and thick wood cutting are your main work.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from 20W to 40W later?
faq.answer: Yes. S1 laser heads are interchangeable — buy a 40W module and swap it on the same enclosure (two screws + connectors). You can also add the optional 2W 1064 nm IR module for more metal work.

faq.question: Is the S1 a hybrid laser like the F1 Ultra?
faq.answer: No. S1 is a diode platform with swappable diode (or IR) heads. Hybrid machines combine fiber and diode sources inside one dual-source product — different category.

mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

moduleSystem.headline: Interchangeable laser heads on the same S1 cabinet
moduleSystem.description: The xTool S1 is sold with different diode modules (10W, 20W, or 40W) or as a bare cabinet — heads swap with two screws and a plug. An optional 2W 1064 nm infrared module adds metal marking without a full fiber galvo. This is not a “hybrid” machine: you replace one head at a time.
